intent: visual concepts only; no runtime integration
common_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE complete fully illustrated landscape 16:9 hub screen for intoDeDung, a medieval fantasy tactical dungeon game. This is a polished visual design proposal, not a wireframe, not a contact sheet. Main subject is the BUTTON DESIGN: give every tab, card, small action and primary button a coherent deliberately crafted material, silhouette, border, icon system and state hierarchy. Keep the existing screen information architecture: four large navigation tabs across top; slim resource line beneath; narrow squad panel on left with EXACTLY THREE compact hero cards (warrior, shieldbearer, archer); broad open fortress courtyard center with three small pixel heroes near a fire; narrow preparation panel on right; clear large primary button bottom-right. Courtyard has stone fortress, plain red and blue cloth flags, tents, stairs, braziers, distant mountains at warm sunset. Do not obscure the central courtyard with extra panels. Background should support UI, slightly calmer than the buttons. Existing screenshot is a composition/world reference only; redraw as a coherent screen, do not copy its six-hero fixture or stale prose. Exact Cyrillic labels: top 'Поход', 'Наёмники', 'Кузнец', 'Колода'; left 'Отряд', 'Воин', 'Щитоносец', 'Лучница', bottom-left secondary 'Дополнительно'; right 'Подготовка', '7 комнат', 'Отряд: 3', 'Колода: 10 карт', 'Готово', bottom-right 'В путь'. Resource line 'Золото 100', 'Эссенция 0'. Active tab is 'Поход'; include crossed-swords, helmet, anvil and card-stack icons respectively. Selected first hero card gets a clear frame. Inactive tabs must remain readable. Text crisp, comfortably large, not decorative handwriting. No long body text, no popup, no invented mechanics, no extra tabs, no logo, no watermark, no outside caption, no collage. Full finished environment art and complete UI from edge to edge. All apparent buttons must look clickable. Preserve useful whitespace.
